title: First Light
subtitle: Establish Primary Energy Grid & Clear Panel Dust
nasaMissionLore: Opportunity Rover (Photovoltaic Solar Arrays & Dust Deposition)

comicPrologue.speaker: commander
comicPrologue.title: Earth Command Transmission
comicPrologue.dialogue: CRADLE-01 is down. The habitat shell is safe, but its solar mast is offline. Leo, bring the rover online.

comicPrologue.speaker: chipi
comicPrologue.title: Chipi-Bot Telemetry
comicPrologue.dialogue: Rover link restored. One clean solar array should wake the base.

comicPrologue.speaker: system
comicPrologue.title: Mission Directive
comicPrologue.dialogue: Drive to the solar mast, clear its dust, collect 2 regolith samples, and return before sunset.

objectives.label: Drive to Solar Array & Clear Dust Deposits
Return to Bio-Dome Airlock to Analyze in Lab

unlockedBadge.title: Solar Pioneer
unlockedBadge.description: Restored 100% solar array efficiency and survived the first Martian night.

title: Red Wall
subtitle: Electrostatic Dust Devil & Hematite Blueberries
nasaMissionLore: Spirit & Opportunity Rovers (Hematite Blueberries in Meridiani Planum)

comicPrologue.speaker: commander
comicPrologue.title: Dust Storm Warning
comicPrologue.dialogue: Satellite imagery shows a massive red dust wall moving in from Crater Alpha. Solar radiation will drop by 60%!

comicPrologue.speaker: chipi
comicPrologue.title: Rover Sortie Recommended
comicPrologue.dialogue: Crater Alpha is 35m South! Board the Exploration Rover [R] to travel quickly and harvest hematite blueberries.

comicPrologue.speaker: system
comicPrologue.title: Field Directive
comicPrologue.dialogue: Navigate to Crater Alpha, harvest 2x Hematite berries, and race back to base airlock before visibility drops.

objectives.label: Drive Rover to Crater Alpha Ridge (35m South)
Return Rover to Habitat Airlock Before Storm Hits

unlockedBadge.title: Hematite Prospector
unlockedBadge.description: Discovered spherical groundwater nodules proving Mars ancient wet history.

title: Frozen Water
subtitle: Drill North Glacier Permafrost Ice Core
nasaMissionLore: Phoenix Lander & Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (Subsurface Glaciers)

comicPrologue.speaker: commander
comicPrologue.title: Critical Water Depletion
comicPrologue.dialogue: Colony water reserves are down! We must drill into North Glacier Trench to tap subsurface permafrost.

comicPrologue.speaker: chipi
comicPrologue.title: Extreme Cold Warning
comicPrologue.dialogue: The trench drops to -80°C! Keep high speed on the Rover to prevent battery freeze.

comicPrologue.speaker: system
comicPrologue.title: Lab Extraction
comicPrologue.dialogue: Extract 2x Ice Core specimens and bring them back to the Bio-Dome Lab to melt into drinking water and oxygen.

objectives.label: Return to Habitat Airlock to Purify Water

unlockedBadge.title: Glacier Driller
unlockedBadge.description: Successfully harvested subsurface Martian water ice to safeguard colony life support.

title: Breath of Mars
subtitle: Inspect MOXIE Atmospheric Extraction Testbed
nasaMissionLore: Perseverance Rover MOXIE (Generating Oxygen from 95% CO2 Atmosphere)

comicPrologue.speaker: commander
comicPrologue.title: Emergency Alert
comicPrologue.dialogue: Dome pressure dropping! A micrometeoroid micro-fracture has breached seal segment Bravo.

comicPrologue.speaker: chipi
comicPrologue.title: MOXIE Testbed Online
comicPrologue.dialogue: Use Space Duct Tape from backpack [E] to seal the breach, then inspect MOXIE tower to synthesize fresh O2!

comicPrologue.speaker: system
comicPrologue.title: Oxygen Stability
comicPrologue.dialogue: Collect the MOXIE catalyst from the East Tower (40m) and return to seal the dome and stabilize oxygen.

objectives.label: Navigate 40m East to MOXIE Extraction Tower
Return to Habitat Airlock & Pressurize O2 Chamber

unlockedBadge.title: MOXIE Oxygen Engineer
unlockedBadge.description: Mastered electro-chemical oxygen synthesis from raw Martian carbon dioxide.

title: Green Shield
subtitle: Harvest Hydroponics & Welcome Ares-1 Crew Landing
environmentalEvent: Cosmic Solar Radiation Flare & Ares-1 Touchdown
nasaMissionLore: Curiosity RAD & ISS Veggie (Space Agriculture & Radiation Shielding)

comicPrologue.speaker: commander
comicPrologue.title: Ares-1 On Final Approach
comicPrologue.dialogue: Cadet Leo! The Ares-1 crewed transport is entering the Martian stratosphere. Touchdown in 4 minutes!

comicPrologue.speaker: chipi
comicPrologue.title: Beacon Activation Required
comicPrologue.dialogue: Drive the Rover 75m to the high Mesa peak and activate the ground laser landing beacon!

comicPrologue.speaker: system
comicPrologue.title: Outpost Graduation
comicPrologue.dialogue: Activate the landing beacon, return to the Bio-Dome, and welcome the first human colony fleet!

objectives.label: Drive Rover 75m South-East to Mesa Ridge
Activate Ares-1 High-Gain Sky Laser Beacon
Return to Habitat Base to Welcome Ares-1 Crew

unlockedBadge.title: Ares-1 Master Explorer
unlockedBadge.description: Graduated as an official NASA Mars Pioneer, unlocking infinite free-roam sandbox.
